# Protocol catalog

<!-- Generated by `npm run catalog:docs` from src/catalog/protocols.js + package.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

128 protocols and 21 cross-protocol boards/tools, 388 npm scripts. In a terminal, `npm run catalog` prints the same view and `npm run catalog -- <protocol>` prints one card.

**Kinds:** *Analytics* prints a live snapshot. *Smoke* is a pass/fail check of the same data source (exit code ≠ 0 when it breaks). *Simulate* quotes or replays on-chain (RPC or fork). *Swap* is a wallet-backed example. *Cross-chain* aggregates one protocol across chains (subgraphs).

<a id="c-dex"></a>

## Spot DEX / AMM

<a id="p-uniswap"></a>

### Uniswap

[uniswap.org](https://uniswap.org) · Data: Subgraphs, on-chain RPC · Analytics · Simulate · Swap · Cross-chain · Fork

V2/V3/V4 AMM. The deepest coverage in the repo: cross-chain trackers, price monitor, fork quotes and swaps.

| Command | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run analytics:uniswap:prices` | Analytics | Compare V2/V3/V4 prices and fee tiers for the configured pairs |
| `npm run simulate:dex:uniswap:v2` | Simulate | Quote-only `uniswap-v2` pool simulation |
| `npm run simulate:dex:uniswap:v3` | Simulate | Quote-only `uniswap-v3` pool simulation |
| `npm run simulate:dex:uniswap:v4` | Simulate | Quote-only `uniswap-v4` pool simulation |
| `npm run swap:uniswap:v2` | Swap | Uniswap V2 swap, including multi-hop routes |
| `npm run swap:uniswap:v3` | Swap | Uniswap V3 swap with fee-tier selection |
| `npm run swap:uniswap:v4` | Swap | Uniswap V4 swap through the singleton PoolManager |
| `npm run crosschain:uniswap:liquidity` | Cross-chain | Live liquidity flows from V2/V3/V4 mint and burn events |
| `npm run crosschain:uniswap:tvl` | Cross-chain | TVL across Uniswap V1–V4 on every configured chain |
| `npm run crosschain:uniswap:volume` | Cross-chain | 24h volume across Uniswap V1–V4 on every configured chain |
| `npm run crosschain:uniswap:weekly:liquidity` | Cross-chain | Daily liquidity changes for the past week |
| `npm run crosschain:uniswap:weekly:tvl` | Cross-chain | Daily TVL history for the past week (CSV in `output/`) |
| `npm run crosschain:uniswap:weekly:volume` | Cross-chain | Daily volume history for the past week (CSV in `output/`) |
| `npm run fork:uniswap:v2` | Fork | Swap WETH→USDC on Uniswap V2 on an Anvil fork and assert USDC increased |
| `npm run fork:uniswap:v3` | Fork | Swap WETH→USDC on Uniswap V3 on an Anvil fork and assert USDC increased |
| `npm run fork:uniswap:v4` | Fork | Swap ETH→USDC on Uniswap V4 through the Universal Router on an Anvil fork and assert USDC increased |

<a id="p-curve"></a>

### Curve Finance

[curve.fi](https://curve.fi) · Data: Subgraphs, on-chain RPC · Analytics · Simulate · Swap · Cross-chain · Fork

Stablecoin-focused AMM.

| Command | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run analytics:curve:pools` | Analytics | Virtual price, balances, APY and imbalance per pool |
| `npm run simulate:dex:curve` | Simulate | Quote-only `curve` pool simulation |
| `npm run swap:curve` | Swap | Swap through a Curve pool |
| `npm run crosschain:curve:tvl` | Cross-chain | TVL across Curve deployments on every configured chain |
| `npm run crosschain:curve:volume` | Cross-chain | 24h volume across Curve deployments |
| `npm run crosschain:curve:weekly:tvl` | Cross-chain | Daily TVL history for the past week (CSV in `output/`) |
| `npm run crosschain:curve:weekly:volume` | Cross-chain | Daily volume history for the past week (CSV in `output/`) |
| `npm run fork:curve:swap` | Fork | Swap USDC→USDT on Curve 3pool on an Anvil fork and assert USDT increased |

<a id="p-balancer"></a>

### Balancer

[balancer.fi](https://balancer.fi) · Data: Subgraphs, on-chain RPC · Analytics · Simulate · Swap · Cross-chain · Fork

Weighted / composable pools behind a single Vault.

| Command | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run analytics:balancer:pools` | Analytics | Weighted pool balances, weight drift and impermanent loss |
| `npm run simulate:dex:balancer` | Simulate | Quote-only `balancer-v2` pool simulation |
| `npm run swap:balancer` | Swap | Swap through the Balancer V2 Vault |
| `npm run crosschain:balancer:tvl` | Cross-chain | TVL across Balancer V2/V3 deployments |
| `npm run crosschain:balancer:volume` | Cross-chain | 24h volume across Balancer deployments |
| `npm run crosschain:balancer:weekly:tvl` | Cross-chain | Daily TVL history for the past week (CSV in `output/`) |
| `npm run crosschain:balancer:weekly:volume` | Cross-chain | Daily volume history for the past week (CSV in `output/`) |
| `npm run fork:balancer:swap` | Fork | Swap WETH→USDC through the Balancer V2 Vault on an Anvil fork |

### SushiSwap

[sushi.com](https://sushi.com) · Data: Subgraphs, on-chain RPC · Analytics · Simulate · Swap · Cross-chain · Fork

V2/V3 AMM on many chains.

| Command | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run analytics:sushiswap:pools` | Analytics | SushiSwap vs Uniswap prices per pair |
| `npm run simulate:dex:sushiswap:v2` | Simulate | Quote-only `sushiswap-v2` pool simulation |
| `npm run simulate:dex:sushiswap:v3` | Simulate | Quote-only `sushiswap-v3` pool simulation |
| `npm run swap:sushiswap` | Swap | SushiSwap V2/V3 swap |
| `npm run crosschain:sushiswap:tvl` | Cross-chain | TVL across SushiSwap V2/V3 deployments |

[docs.uniswap.org/contracts/uniswapx/overview](https://docs.uniswap.org/contracts/uniswapx/overview) · Data: On-chain RPC (reactor `Fill` logs) · Analytics · Simulate · Swap

Signed Dutch-style orders filled through a reactor, not pool routers.

> **Context**
>
> The fill replay scans logs in chunks (`UNISWAPX_MAX_BLOCKS`, `UNISWAPX_LOG_CHUNK`) and soft-fails on revert unless `UNISWAPX_REPLAY_STRICT=1`.

| Command | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run analytics:uniswapx:activity` | Analytics | Recent `Fill` events on the reactor (`CHAIN`, `UNISWAPX_REACTOR`, `UNISWAPX_MAX_BLOCKS`) |
| `npm run simulate:uniswapx:fill` | Simulate | Replay a historical fill via `eth_call` at its block (`UNISWAPX_REPLAY_TX`) |
| `npm run swap:uniswapx` | Swap | Pointer to UniswapX monitor and replay (orders are signed, not routed) |

>
> September 2026 onchain options notional more than doubled to ~$4.83B (+121.7% MoM). Derive ~$3.8B with share 88.1% → 79.3%; Paradex notional +285% and open interest >$250M; Hypercall ~11.2% share ([CryptoBriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/derive-leads-onchain-options-volume-doubles/), 2026-10-05; [Coinfomania](https://coinfomania.com/onchain-options-market-surges-to-4-83b-as-competition-grows/), 2026-10-05; [X](https://x.com/Delphi_Digital/status/2107083828389187613), 2026-10-05). Analytics prints trailing 24h/7d/30d notional and premium, not that calendar month. Hypercall volume is not on DefiLlama.

<a id="p-blast"></a>

### Blast

[blast.io](https://blast.io) · Data: DefiLlama chains · Analytics · Smoke

Blast L2 (chainId 81457). Chain TVL from DefiLlama `/v2/chains`, not a protocol slug. The smoke allows $0 TVL while the chain winds down and fails if the Blast row disappears.

> **Context**
>
> Blast L2 is shutting down (announced 2026-10-02) because operating costs exceed revenue; TVL ~$32M vs >$2B peak (−98%); ~$63.03M still in the canonical bridge on Ethereum; normal-UI withdrawals until 2026-10-26 after ~1-week Lido unwind ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-02-blast-ethereum-layer-2-shutting-down-417583), 2026-10-02; [Cointelegraph](https://cointelegraph.com/news/blast-to-wind-down-ethereum-l2-after-costs-outpace-revenue), 2026-10-02; [The Crypto Times](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/10/02/blast-shuts-down-ethereum-l2-as-operating-costs-exceed-revenue/), 2026-10-02). The monitor reads chain TVL, not the Ethereum bridge balance.

| Command | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run analytics:blast:chain` | Analytics | Blast chain TVL from DefiLlama `/v2/chains` (`LLAMA_CHAIN_NAME=Blast`), plus 7d/30d change |
| `npm run simulate:blast:smoke` | Smoke | Smoke for `analytics:blast:chain` |

DefiLlama's daily record close is $272.8M on 2026-10-01. Analytics prints live chain TVL and DEX volume, not stablecoins or RWAs.

<a id="p-abstract"></a>

### Abstract

[abs.xyz](https://www.abs.xyz/) · Data: DefiLlama chains · Analytics · Smoke

Ethereum L2 (chainId 2741) winding down. Chain TVL from DefiLlama `/v2/chains` (name `Abstract`), plus DEX volume. Shuts down 2026-12-15. Not the protocol slug `abstract`.

> **Context**
>
> Abstract (Pudgy Penguins / Igloo) is winding down; the chain shuts down 2026-12-15 and funds not bridged out become inaccessible. Peaked ~$57M TVL / $32M daily DEX volume; reported ~$9.5M TVL / ~$316K daily DEX volume at the announcement ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/ecosystems/2026-10-06-abstract-ethereum-layer-2-shutting-down-pudgy-penguins-igloo-417855), 2026-10-06; [TokenPost](https://www.tokenpost.com/news/technology/27126), 2026-10-07; [X](https://x.com/NickPreszler/status/2107574455106994679), 2026-10-06). Analytics prints live `/v2/chains` TVL and `/overview/dexs/Abstract`, not that snapshot. Protocol slug `abstract` is a separate Chain-category page and is not this monitor.

| Command | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run analytics:abstract:chain` | Analytics | Abstract chain TVL from DefiLlama `/v2/chains` (`LLAMA_CHAIN_NAME=Abstract`), 7d/30d change, DEX volume, and the 2026-12-15 shutdown note |
| `npm run simulate:abstract:smoke` | Smoke | Smoke for `analytics:abstract:chain` |
